notes.title: LOONEWS 7 | Erogoddess: Mirage Released & 69 Summon Succubus Update
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/d41f9d1a2127f3e3b333eae8217c72c640f19c1a.png

Dear friends Erogoddess: Mirage is now available! Dating simulator with feminized Egyptian gods. Ra, Anubis, Seth, Osiris, Horus and other gods are waiting for you. Discover new gods by spinning the wheel of fortune. In the near future we will give away 10 keys to the game in our Discord!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/be825650ddb0b013874751f2ca38727bd9afe884.gif

Also for 69 Summon Succubus an update has been released! The cute wolf Lucia has been added to the game.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/655ea170a027e0d7adc70659f89072959de6e43b.png

notes.title: LOONEWS 3 | Release Erogoddess: Asgard
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/3c7818b44e6bdf005ae92a3d854b9c24f9cfca2f.png

Dear friends! We have great news - the game Erogoddess: Asgard has been released! Dive into a dating simulator with mini games and collect all the feminized bugs of the Scandinavian pantheon. Also available with the game are two DLCs, a wallpaper pack and a digital artbook. Enjoy the game!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/2dcf5f86062783bb8e4e1d8aa2477ea25dab8a1e.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875490/_/

notes.title: LOONEWS 1 | Erogoddess: Olympus release and future!
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/d350b9b0ddeeca65761c5b491792bdf3f92152bb.png

Dear friends! We have good news! The game Erogoddess: Olympus has been released. A dating simulator with feminized Greek gods, be sure to check it out. A 15% discount is available at launch!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2602000/Erogoddess_Olympus/

The Erogoddess: Asgard page is also open, the release is planned for August, add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875490/Erogoddess_Asgard/

In just a week, Fairy Massage: Lite, the prologue to the main game, will be available for free.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016780/Fairy_Massage_Lite/

Fairy Massage is in its final stages of development, the planned release window is early September!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992590/Fairy_Massage/

notes.title: We are working on a big update! 💦💦💦
